value.rationale: A perfect-matching deletion from the twin-rich K_{n,n} is a canonical smallest structural change that sharply reduces neighbor-locating requirements from 2n to n+1. The new complete infinite-family classification explains every permissible optimum merge, proves the stronger equivalence of all locating and neighbor-locating proper colorings, and provides a natural exact optimizer census with distinct exponential terms.
